Our Dedicated Team—The Secret to Your Event’s Success

At SaltBlock Hospitality, we believe flawless events are built by exceptional people. Our unique approach to event planning and execution is powered by a specialized, fully in-house team of hospitality professionals—each an expert in their craft. Unlike others, we never rely on outsourcing. Every team member is carefully trained and developed internally to ensure seamless, high-touch service from start to finish.

Our event planning process is a true collaboration across multiple departments, with each team reviewing your event from every angle to guarantee that no detail is overlooked. Leading our culinary program is our Executive Chef and Director of Culinary Experience, who oversees the entire food journey—from the way guests interact with each dish to its final execution. With two skilled Sous Chefs managing production and a talented team of event chefs onsite, every plate we serve reflects precision, creativity, and passion.

On the day of your event, our On-Site Experience Team, guided by our Director of Guest and Beverage Experience, ensures every element of service and beverage exceeds expectations. Our innovative bar program—crafted in-house with curated ingredients and bespoke reductions—brings a personalized and elevated touch to your event. Supporting them is our Staffing Manager, who ensures every service professional is fully prepared to handle the complexities of your celebration with grace and expertise.

Behind the scenes, our Logistics Team works tirelessly to create a seamless flow. The Operations Manager coordinates timing, setup, and asset allocation, while our Warehouse Manager meticulously prepares and checks every item to ensure flawless execution. Meanwhile, our Sales Team partners with you to bring your vision to life, developing thoughtful proposals that align with your style and budget. Once finalized, our Detail Coordinators refine guest counts and confirm every detail, ensuring all departments are perfectly aligned.

By developing our team entirely in-house, we guarantee that the professionals managing your event are not only highly skilled but also deeply invested in your success. From first consultation to final toast, our collaborative approach ensures nothing is left to chance and every element is executed with excellence.

When you choose SaltBlock, you’re not just choosing a caterer—you’re partnering with a collective of hospitality professionals devoted to making your event unforgettable.
